[RHIM.2.4] The engine must give `corr` the empty string `""` on any fact of a
hydration target asserted without a value for it, and that value is the interned
empty string, so a live fact matches the live-only test ([LHYD.4.1.4]). A
live-emitted fact therefore carries `corr == ""`; only the adapter sets it
non-empty.

---
